subject: Animation
title: The Lion King's Billion-Dollar Surprise
description: Learn The Lion King's Billion-Dollar Surprise in one minute.

hook.text: Disney considered The Lion King the B-team project. The best animators chose Pocahontas instead.

buildup.text: The Lion King tackled heavy themes for a children's film: death, responsibility, and betrayal.

discovery.text: Elton John and Tim Rice wrote songs that became cultural anthems far beyond the film itself.

twist.text: The Lion King earned nearly a billion dollars. The supposed B-project became Disney's biggest hit.

climax.text: It spawned a Broadway musical that became the highest-grossing show in theater history.

punchline.text: The project nobody wanted became Disney's crown jewel.

quiz.question: Why did Disney executives underestimate The Lion King?
options: They thought animated musicals were outdated
They considered it a lesser project and assigned top animators to Pocahontas instead
They thought audiences would not watch animal characters

details.summary: The Lion King was not expected to be a hit — Disney's top animators chose to work on Pocahontas instead. It became the highest-grossing animated film in history at the time, earning nearly a billion dollars and producing one of the most profitable franchises ever.
details.whyItMatters: The Lion King's unexpected mega-success demonstrated that industry predictions about what will succeed are often wrong. The film given to the B-team became the biggest animated hit of its era — a lesson in the unpredictability of creative works.
takeaways: The Lion King became the highest-grossing animated film of its era
Top Disney animators considered it the lesser project compared to Pocahontas
Elton John's soundtrack and the Hamlet-inspired story proved universally resonant

faq.question: Why did Disney's top animators not want to work on The Lion King?
faq.answer: Pocahontas was considered the prestige project — a serious, award-worthy drama. The Lion King was seen as a lesser assignment with talking animals in Africa. The animators who chose Pocahontas watched in disbelief as The Lion King became a cultural phenomenon.

faq.question: How much money has The Lion King franchise generated?
faq.answer: The original film, Broadway musical, merchandise, theme park attractions, and 2019 CGI remake have generated billions of dollars. The Broadway show alone has earned over $1 billion. The Lion King is one of the most profitable entertainment properties ever created.
